remarks: Welcome to Midtown Estates-where location, light, and lifestyle come together seamlessly. Ideally situated in the best spot within the complex, this exceptional townhome enjoys natural light and is just steps from vibrant downtown living.  Thoughtfully designed with a lot of extra custom finishes throughout, the home features hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and elegant millwork. The welcoming entry foyer, complete with built-ins, opens to a sun-drenched main level boasting an open-concept layout. The living room and dining area flow effortlessly to a private balcony-perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation.  At the heart of the home, the designer kitchen impresses with Carrara marble countertops, a breakfast bar, and stainless steel appliances, blending style and functionality. A powder room completes this level.  Upstairs, two spacious bedrooms share a beautifully appointed hall bath featuring both a soaking tub and separate shower. The entire third level is dedicated to the primary suite, offering a peaceful retreat with a custom walk-in closet and a full bath.  Crowning this home is a private rooftop deck with sweeping views-an ideal setting for entertaining or unwinding in style.  Additional highlights include an attached two-car garage with epoxy floors and custom storage. Truly move-in ready, this is a rare opportunity not to be missed.
